source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 20.4.1, printed page 66.

blocks.text: Jab benzene zyada (excess) hawa mein jalaya jaye to yeh poori tarah oxidise ho kar CO₂ aur H₂O ban jata hai. Lekin is ka shola (flame) dhuwen wala (smoky) hota hai; yahi aromatic compounds ki pehchan ka test hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Benzene mein carbon zyada aur hydrogen kam hai (C : H = 1 : 1), is liye hawa mein jalte waqt kuch carbon poora nahi jalta aur kaale dhuwen (soot) ki shakal mein nikalta hai. Alkanes jaise hexane saaf (kam dhuwen wala) shola dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Benzene ke jalne ki equation balanced hai? Check karein.
blocks.explanation: Baen taraf: 12 C, 12 H, 30 O. Daen taraf: 12CO₂ mein 12 C; 6H₂O mein 12 H; O = 24 + 6 = 30. Dono taraf barabar, is liye balanced hai.

items: 2C₆H₆ + 15O₂ → 12CO₂ + 6H₂O; dhuwen wala shola aromatic compound ki nishani hai.
